description: List a form's submissions (newest first) so you can read or summarize them — e.g. 'summarize this week's feedback' or 'any complaints in the responses?'. Email and phone answers are hidden unless `include_contact_details` is set.

include_contact_details.description: Include email and phone answers. Set this only when the user asks for them, e.g. 'who signed up?' or 'list the emails'. Default false.

name: get_form_responses

count.description: Total matching rows across all pages.

error.description: Present only when the tool failed (isError): cause, retryable, message.

message.description: Set when there are no responses yet.

next.description: URL of the next page, or null on the last page.
